candidates.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
candidates.finding: OpenAI's engineering account distinguishes eligibility, session creation, retrieval, candidate hydration/filtering, server-side delivery and acknowledged user-facing display as separately logged outcomes. It describes privacy-controlled measurement, model-based quality evaluation and human feedback. The account concerns advertising infrastructure, not robotics, and reports OpenAI's own design rather than a publicly reproducible implementation.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Propose a non-ranking, synthetic-only event-lineage completeness check for HILO telemetry: distinguish 'not eligible for capture', 'capture not requested', 'event not produced', 'event rejected', 'event recorded' and 'event independently reviewed' from actual human use or deployment. Record missingness and provenance separately; a logged event is not a verified human keep decision, field hour or certification. Do not deploy ad technology, collect conversations, change WANTED scoring or make model calls.
